draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Aranmula! This temple town on the Pampa holds the oldest river boat festival in Kerala, where snake boats race in pairs to full-throated singing during Onam.
draft.hungryLine: The food to know here is the Aranmula Valla Sadhya, a feast served at the temple mainly during the Onam season.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Walk to the Aranmula Parthasarathy Temple, about 12 minutes away, then the Mangattu Palace close by.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Take the 57 steps down from the temple's northern tower to the banks of the Pampa.
moodReplies.surprise-me: The Thanka Anki, the golden attire of Lord Ayyappa at Sabarimala, is kept at the temple here.

spots.name: Aranmula Parthasarathy Temple
spots.detail: 12 min walk · Ancient Krishna temple with 18th century murals

spots.name: Aranmula Mangattu Palace
spots.detail: 9 min walk · Royal palace where the family still lives

spots.name: Vijnana Kala Vedi
spots.detail: On the way to Kozhencherry · School for Kathakali, dance, music and Kalaripayattu

legends.title: Arjuna's temple
legends.body: Legend says the five Pandavas each built one temple in Kerala, and this one was built by Arjuna. Krishna is worshipped here as Arjuna's charioteer.

legends.title: Boats from the Mahabharata
legends.body: The yearly snake boat race is linked to the legends of the Mahabharata. The boats move in pairs to the rhythm of singing and shouting.

tips.title: Come during Onam.
tips.body: The boat race and the Valla Sadhya both happen around Onam, in August to September.

tips.title: Be ready for steps.
tips.body: There are 18 steps up to the eastern tower and 57 steps down from the northern tower to the river.

story.title: Named in Tamil classics
story.body: The Parthasarathy Temple is one of the 108 Divya Desams revered by the Alvar saints. It even finds mention in Tamil classics.

story.title: Murals on the walls
story.body: The temple's fine murals date from the 18th century. The Thanka Anki, donated by the king of Travancore, is also kept here.

story.title: Rice instead of runways
story.body: In 2015 the approval for a proposed airport was withdrawn. Farming restarted on the Aranmula Puncha paddy fields in 2016, and Aranmula Rice was launched in 2017.

story.title: The flood's discovery
story.body: Floods on the Pampa that year exposed a terracotta archaeological site at Kozhippalam, about 1 km away.
